style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">12. Election of Directors</span></div><div style="margin-top:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">All directors will stand for election at the annual meeting of shareholders. If the majority shareholder&#8217;s holdings were ever to fall below 50% for any non-contested elections of directors, any director nominee who receives a greater number of votes &#8220;withheld&#8221; from his or her election than votes &#8220;for&#8221; in such election shall tender his or her resignation.  Within 90 days after certification of the election results, the board will decide, through a process managed by the nominations and corporate governance committee and excluding the nominee in question, whether to accept the resignation.  Absent a compelling reason for the director to remain on the board, the board shall accept the resignation. The board will promptly disclose and, if applicable, the reasons for rejecting the tendered resignation.  </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">13. Director Orientation and Continuing Education</span></div><div style="margin-top:7pt;padding-left:18pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(a)   </span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Orientation</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:18pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">New non-employee directors will receive a comprehensive orientation from appropriate executives regarding the corporation&#8217;s business and affairs.</span></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(b)   </span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Continuing Education</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:18pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Reviews of aspects of the corporation&#8217;s operations will be presented by appropriate employees from time to time as part of the agenda of regular board meetings.  The board will also normally conduct an on-site visit to a location other than the corporation&#8217;s headquarters in conjunction with one or more regular board meetings every year.</span></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="height:45pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">194</span></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"/><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%"> </span></div></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">14. Chairman and chief executive officer </span></div><div style="margin-top:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The board currently believes that it is appropriate and efficient for the corporation&#8217;s chief executive officer to also act as chairman of the board.  However, the board retains the authority to separate those functions if it deems such action appropriate in the future. </span></div><div style="padding-left:27.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-0.35pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-left:27.35pt;padding-right:8.65pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Position description </span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:27.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The chairman and chief executive officer shall: </span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:74.9pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">plan and organize all activities of the board of directors; </span></div><div style="margin-top:5pt;padding-left:75pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">ensure that the board receives sufficient, timely information on all material aspects of the corporation's operations and financial affairs; </span></div><div style="margin-top:5pt;padding-left:75pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">chair annual and special meetings of the shareholders; </span></div><div style="margin-top:5pt;padding-left:75pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">conduct the general management and direction of the business and affairs of the corporation; </span></div><div style="margin-top:5pt;padding-left:75pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">recommend to the board of directors a strategic plan for the corporation's business and, when approved by the board of directors, implement this strategic plan and report to the board of directors on the implementation of this strategic plan; </span></div><div style="margin-top:5pt;padding-left:75pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">develop and implement operational policies to guide the corporation within the limits prescribed by the corporation's by-laws and the directions adopted by the board of directors; </span></div><div style="margin-top:5pt;padding-left:75pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">under the oversight of the board of directors, design and implement an enterprise risk management framework, and develop appropriate systems to manage such risks; </span></div><div style="margin-top:5pt;padding-left:75pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">under the oversight of the board of directors, develop plans for succession planning for senior management, including the appointing, training and monitoring thereof, and implement those plans; </span></div><div style="margin-top:5pt;padding-left:75pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">ensure compliance with the corporation's code of ethics and business conduct so as to foster a culture of integrity throughout the company; and </span></div><div style="margin-top:5pt;padding-left:75pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">ensure effective internal controls and management information systems are in place. </span></div><div style="margin-top:5pt;padding-left:27.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-0.35pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Minimum shareholding requirements </span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:27.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The chairman and chief executive officer shall hold, or shall, within three years after his appointment as chairman and chief executive officer, acquire shares of the corporation, including common shares and restricted stock units, of a value no less than five times his base salary. </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div style="height:45pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">195</span></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"/><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%"> </span></div></div><div><table style="border-collapse:collapse;display:inline-table;margin-bottom:5pt;vertical-align:text-bottom;width:97.727%"><tr><td style="width:1.0%"/><td style="width:98.900%"/><td style="width:0.1%"/></tr><tr><td colspan="3" style="background-color:#deebf6;border-bottom:6pt solid #0070c0;border-top:6pt solid #0070c0;padding:2px 1pt 2px 1.02pt;text-align:left;vertical-align:middle"><span style="color:#0070c0;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Audit Committee Charter</span></td></tr></table></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">1. Purpose of the Committee </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The primary purpose of the audit committee (the "committee") is oversight of financial reporting, compliance and controls.  The independence of the committee is a critical component of corporate governance as the committee holds the board and management accountable and fosters trust and confidence for all stakeholders, which is vital for the generation of long-term value. The committee shall assist the board of directors (the "board") in fulfilling its responsibility to oversee: </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">management's conduct of the corporation's financial reporting process, </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">the integrity of the financial statements and other financial information provided by the corporation to Canadian securities regulators, the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") and the public, </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">the corporation's system of internal accounting and financial controls, </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">the corporation's compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">the performance of the corporation's internal audit function, </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">the independent auditors' qualifications, performance, and independence, </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">the annual independent audit of the corporation's financial statements, and</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">compliance and legal risks including investigations and litigation of a material financial nature.</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The corporation's management is responsible for preparing the corporation's financial statements. The independent auditors are responsible for auditing those financial statements. Management, including the internal audit function, and the independent auditors, have more time, knowledge, and detailed information about the corporation than do committee members. Consequently, in carrying out its oversight responsibilities, the committee is not providing any expert or special assurance as to the corporation's financial statements, or any professional certification as to the independent auditors' work, including with respect to auditor independence. Each member of the committee shall be entitled to rely on the integrity of people and organizations from whom the committee receives information and the accuracy of such information, including representations by management and the independent auditors regarding non-audit services provided by the independent auditors. </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">2. Committee Membership </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall consist of no fewer than three members. Committee members shall be appointed by the board from among its independent members who shall serve at the pleasure of the board, but only so long as each member continues to be a director of the corporation and is independent. Each member of the committee must satisfy such criteria of independence as the board may establish and such additional regulatory or listing requirements as the board may determine to be applicable or appropriate. Each member of the committee shall serve only so long as he or she continues to be a director of the corporation and is independent. The actual number of members shall be determined from time to time by resolution of the board.</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div style="height:45pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">196</span></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"/><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%"> </span></div></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Accordingly, each member of the committee shall be financially literate within a reasonable period of time after appointment to the committee; must be "independent" as defined in the board charter; and may not serve on more than two other public company audit committees unless the board determines that such simultaneous service would not impair the ability of the member to serve effectively on the committee. In addition, at least one member of the committee shall be an "audit committee financial expert" as defined by applicable laws. </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">3. Committee Structure and Operation </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The chair and vice-chair of the committee shall be designated by the board from among the members of the committee. The committee shall fix its own rules of procedure and shall meet where and as provided by such rules or by resolution of the committee. In addition to the regular meeting schedule established by the committee, the chair of the committee may call a special meeting at any time. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:8pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The chair, or in that person's absence, the vice-chair or in the vice-chair's absence, an alternate designated by the committee, shall: </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;preside at committee meetings; </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;ensure that meetings of the committee are held in accordance with this charter; and </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(c)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review, and modify if necessary the agenda of the meetings of this committee in advance to ensure that the committee may effectively carry out its duties. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:5pt;margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">A majority of the members of the committee shall constitute a quorum thereof. Every question shall be decided by a majority of the votes cast on the question and in the case of an equality of votes, the chair of the meeting shall be entitled to a second or casting vote. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:5pt;margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall designate its secretary. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Meetings of the committee may be called by any member or by the external auditors of the corporation and notice of every meeting shall be given to the external auditors. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:5pt;margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The external auditors and the internal auditor of the corporation shall report directly to the audit committee.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:5pt;margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall act only on the affirmative vote of a majority of the members at a meeting or by unanimous written consent. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:5pt;margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee may establish sub-committees to carry out such duties as the committee may assign. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:12pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">4.  Committee Activities</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The following shall be the common recurring activities of the committee in carrying out its purposes. These activities are set forth as a guide with the understanding that the committee may diverge from this guide as appropriate given the circumstances. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:27.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-27.35pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall: </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;recommend the external auditors to be appointed by the shareholders, review and recommend their remuneration to the board, approve advances on such remuneration, which shall be paid by the corporation, and oversee their work, including the resolution of disagreements between management and the external auditor regarding financial reporting.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div style="height:45pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">197</span></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"/><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%"> </span></div></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;approve the proposed current year audit program of the external auditors and assess the results of the program after the end of the program period. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(c)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;approve in advance any non-audit services that are permitted by applicable law to be performed by the external auditors after considering the effect of such services on their independence. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(d)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;receive from the external auditors a formal written statement delineating all relationships between the external auditor and the corporation consistent with Independence Standards Board Standard 1, and shall actively engage in a dialogue with the external auditor with respect to any disclosed relationships or services that may impact the objectivity and independence of the external auditor and shall recommend that the board take any appropriate action to oversee the independence of the external auditor. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(e)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;maintain hiring policies for employees and former employees of the independent auditors. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(f)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;establish procedures for the receipt, retention and treatment of complaints received by the corporation regarding accounting, internal accounting controls, or auditing matters and the confidential, anonymous submission by employees of the corporation of concerns regarding questionable accounting or auditing matters. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(g)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;approve the proposed current year audit program of the internal auditors and assess the results of the program after the end of each quarter. &#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(h)  review the adequacy of the corporation's system of internal controls, management information systems and auditing procedures. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:27pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(i)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review the accounting and financial reporting processes of the corporation. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(j)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;provide oversight regarding the corporation&#8217;s tax compliance activities.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(k)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;approve changes proposed by management in accounting principles and practices, and review changes proposed by the accounting profession or other regulatory bodies which impact directly on such principles and practices. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(l)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review the quarterly news release of financial and operating results, the annual and quarterly financial statements of the corporation, any accounting items affecting the statements and the overall format and content of the statements, and the related management discussion and analysis, prior to approval of such news release and financial statements by the board of directors. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(m)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review the results of the corporation's business ethics compliance program. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(n)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review related party transactions to assess the commercial reasonableness of those transactions, and to ensure that all such transactions are entered into in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;text-indent:27pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(o)   provide oversight regarding the corporation&#8217;s anonymous ethics hotline.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:27pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(p)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review annually a summary of senior management expense accounts. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(q)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;annually evaluate, along with the other members of the board, management, the controller, and the general auditor, the qualifications, performance and independence of the independent auditors, including the performance of the lead audit partner.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div style="height:45pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">198</span></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"/><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(r)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review any allegation that an executive officer or director may have violated the corporation's Standards of Business Conduct and report its findings to the board and the general auditor.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(s)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;require attendance at its meetings by members of management, as the committee may direct. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(t)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;undertake such additional activities within the scope of its responsibilities as it may deem appropriate.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">5. Committee Evaluation</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee will annually complete a self-evaluation of the committee's own performance and effectiveness and will consider whether any changes to the committee&#8217;s charter are appropriate. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">6. Resources and Authority of the Committee </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee has exclusive authority with respect to the retention of the independent auditors described in section 4 of this charter. In discharging its oversight role, the committee is empowered to investigate any matter brought to its attention with full access to all books, records, facilities, and personnel of the corporation. The committee also has the authority to retain outside advisors, including legal counsel, auditors, or other experts, as it deems appropriate; to approve the fees and expenses of such advisors; and to incur such other ordinary administrative expenses as are necessary or appropriate in carrying out its duties. </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div><table style="border-collapse:collapse;display:inline-table;margin-bottom:5pt;vertical-align:text-bottom;width:97.727%"><tr><td style="width:1.0%"/><td style="width:98.900%"/><td style="width:0.1%"/></tr><tr><td colspan="3" style="background-color:#deebf6;border-bottom:6pt solid #0070c0;border-top:6pt solid #0070c0;padding:2px 1pt 2px 1.02pt;text-align:left;vertical-align:middle"><span style="color:#0070c0;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Safety and Sustainability Committee Charter</span></td></tr></table></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">1. Purpose of the Committee</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:7pt;padding-right:8.65pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The primary purpose of the safety and sustainability committee (the 'committee') is to provide oversight and guidance on matters related to safety, security, health and the environment, with a view to generation of long-term value. This includes environmental, health, personnel and process safety, security and sustainability risks and performance, including the risks associated with climate change. It also includes compliance with legislation and the assessment of long-term impacts of public policy, climate change, stakeholder and Indigenous relations on corporate performance, while fostering long-term sustainability and responsible business practices.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:7pt;padding-left:13.7pt;padding-right:8.65pt;text-indent:-13.7pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">2. Committee Membership</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall consist of no fewer than three members, to be appointed by the board of directors from among (a) the independent directors; and (b) the non-independent directors who are not members of the corporation's management, who shall serve at the pleasure of the board, but only so long as he or she continues to be a director of the corporation. The actual number of members shall be determined from time to time by resolution of the board. Members of the committee should be suitably knowledgeable in matters pertaining to public issues. </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">3. Committee Structure and Operation</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The chair and vice-chair of the committee shall be designated by the board from among the members of the committee. The committee shall fix its own rules of procedure and shall meet where and as provided by such rules or by resolution of the committee. </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div style="height:45pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">199</span></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"/><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%"> </span></div></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The chair, or in that person's absence, the vice-chair or in the vice-chair's absence, an alternate designated by the committee, shall: </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-left:27pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;preside at committee meetings; </span></div><div style="padding-left:27pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-left:27pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;ensure that meetings of the committee are held in accordance with this charter; and </span></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(c)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review, and modify if necessary the agenda of the meetings of this committee in advance to ensure that the committee may effectively carry out its duties. </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">A majority of the members of the committee shall constitute a quorum thereof. Every question shall be decided by a majority of the votes cast on the question and in the case of an equality of votes, the chair of the meeting shall be entitled to a second or casting vote. </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall designate its secretary.</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Meetings of the committee may be called by any member.</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span by unanimous written consent.</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee may establish subcommittees consisting of one or more members to carry out such duties as the committee may delegate.</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span policies, programs and practices on environment, health, safety, and security, including the impact, risks and disclosure associated with climate change and greenhouse gas emissions, and make such recommendations to the board with respect thereto as it may deem advisable.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.65pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span legislative, regulatory and corporation standards for environmental, health, safety, security and sustainability practices and matters, including the impact, risks and disclosure associated with climate change and greenhouse gas emissions, and provide guidance to the board on the results and adequacy thereof. </span></div><div relating to matters of significance to the corporation, including environment, health, safety, security and sustainability issues and the impact, risks and disclosure associated with climate change and greenhouse gas emissions, as they may impact the corporation's operations.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span significance to the corporation, including the impact of the environment, health, safety and security on the operations of the corporation and provide guidance to the board and management as to the appropriate response of the corporation thereto. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span government, stakeholder and Indigenous relations.</span></div><div style="height:45pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div </span></div></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span investment strategies and programs, including committee authority to approve all grants or contributions for charitable contributions and local community contributions in excess of $500,000. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span
