Committee Evaluation</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee will annually complete a self-evaluation of the committee's own performance and effectiveness and will consider whether any changes to the committee&#8217;s charter are appropriate. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:12pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">6. Resources and Authority of the Committee</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee has the authority to retain such outside advisors, including legal counsel or other experts, as it deems appropriate, and to approve the fees and expenses of such advisors.</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><table style="border-collapse:collapse;display:inline-table;margin-bottom:5pt;vertical-align:text-bottom;width:97.727%"><tr><td style="width:1.0%"/><td style="width:98.900%"/><td style="width:0.1%"/></tr><tr><td colspan="3" style="background-color:#deebf6;border-bottom:6pt solid #0070c0;border-top:6pt solid #0070c0;padding:2px 1pt 2px 1.02pt;text-align:left;vertical-align:middle"><span style="color:#0070c0;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Executive Resources Committee Charter</span></td></tr></table></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">1. Purpose of the Committee</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:7pt;padding-right:8.65pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The primary purpose of the executive resources committee (the &#8220;committee&#8221;) is to assess and make recommendations to the board regarding the evaluation and compensation of the corporation's chief executive officer (the &#8220;CEO&#8221;), the other officers of the corporation, and the General Auditor, and to discharge the responsibilities of the committee under applicable rules and regulations. The committee also makes recommendations to the board regarding succession planning and development for senior executives and positions as needed and makes recommendations to the board regarding the appointment of officers. The compensation and succession programs are aligned with the core elements of the majority shareholder&#8217;s compensation and talent management programs that incentivize the creation of long-term value.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.65pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">2. Committee Membership</span></div><div style="margin-top:7pt;padding-right:8.65pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall consist of no fewer than three members. Committee members shall be appointed by the board of directors from among its independent members, who shall serve at the pleasure of the board, but only so long as each member continues to be a director of the corporation. The actual number of members shall be determined from time to time by resolution of the board. Members of the committee should be suitably knowledgeable in matters pertaining to executive compensation. </span></div><div style="margin-top:7pt;padding-right:8.65pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">3. Committee Structure and Operation</span></div><div style="margin-top:7pt;padding-right:8.65pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The chair and vice-chair of the committee shall be designated by the board from among the members of the committee. The committee shall fix its own rules of procedure and shall meet where and as provided by such rules or by resolution of the committee. </span></div><div style="height:45pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">201</span></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"/><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%"> </span></div></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The chair, or in that person's absence, the vice-chair or in the vice-chair's absence, an alternate designated by the committee, shall: </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;preside at committee meetings; </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;ensure that meetings of the committee are held in accordance with this charter; and </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(c)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review, and modify if necessary the agenda of the meetings of this committee in advance to ensure that the committee may effectively carry out its duties. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:5pt;margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">A majority of the members of the committee shall constitute a quorum thereof. Every question shall be decided by a majority of the votes cast on the question and in the case of an equality of votes, the chair of the meeting shall be entitled to a second or casting vote. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall designate its secretary.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Meetings of the committee may be called by any member.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall act only on the affirmative vote of a majority of the members at a meeting or by unanimous written consent.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee may establish subcommittees consisting of one or more members to carry out such duties as the committee may delegate.</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">4. Committee Activities</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The following shall be the common recurring activities of the committee in carrying out its purposes. These activities are set forth as a guide with the understanding that the committee may diverge from this guide as appropriate given the circumstances.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall:</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(a)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:5.78pt">review the corporate goals and objectives relevant to the performance and compensation of the CEO.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(b)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:5.78pt">review proposed terms of any new incentive programs and major amendments to existing ones, making recommendations to the board as deemed advisable.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(c)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:6.34pt">oversee and make recommendations to the board regarding annual performance evaluation of the CEO, the other officers of the corporation, and the General Auditor.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(d)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:5.78pt">make recommendations to the board regarding salaries and other compensation (including supplemental compensation such as cash bonuses and incentive bonus units, long-term incentive compensation such as restricted stock units, and any other payments for service), for the CEO, the other officers of the corporation, and the General Auditor. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(e)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:5.78pt">at least annually review succession planning and development strategies for the CEO, the other officers of the corporation, and the General Auditor.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(f)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:8.57pt">periodically review the executive development system to ensure that it foresees the corporation&#8217;s senior management requirements and provides for early identification and development of key resources.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(g)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:5.78pt">make recommendations to the board regarding the appointment of officers.</span></div><div style="height:45pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">202</span></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"/><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%"> </span></div></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(h)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:4.57pt">review and make recommendations to the board regarding the annual report on compensation for inclusion in the corporation&#8217;s management proxy circular in accordance with applicable legal requirements.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(i)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:9.12pt">provide oversight regarding risks arising from the corporation's compensation policies and practices for employees as required by Canadian securities regulators and stock exchanges on which the corporation&#8217;s stock trades.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(j)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:9.12pt">consider factors that could affect the independence or represent a conflict of interest on the part of any compensation consultant, independent legal counsel, or other adviser the committee may retain and report thereon as required by Canadian securities regulators and stock exchanges on which the corporation&#8217;s stock trades.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(k)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:6.34pt">administer the company&#8217;s Policy for the Recovery of Erroneously Awarded Compensation.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(l)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:9.12pt">require attendances at its meetings by members of management, as the committee may direct.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(m)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:3.01pt">undertake such additional activities within the scope of its responsibilities as it may deem appropriate. </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">5. Committee Evaluation</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee will annually complete a self-evaluation of the committee's own performance and effectiveness and will consider whether any changes to the committee&#8217;s charter are appropriate. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">6. Resources and Authority of the Committee</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee and, with the approval of the committee, any member, may engage independent counsel, compensation consultants or other advisors at the expense of the corporation.  The committee shall be directly responsible for the appointment, compensation and oversight of the work of any independent legal counsel, compensation consultant or other advisor retained by the committee. The committee may select outside legal counsel, a compensation consultant or other advisor (an &#8220;Advisor&#8221;) to the committee only after taking into consideration all factors relevant to the Advisor&#8217;s independence from management, including the following: </span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">the provision of other services to the corporation by the person that employs the Advisor;</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">the amount of fees received from the corporation by the person that employs the Advisor as a percentage of such that person&#8217;s total revenue;</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">the policies and procedures of the person that employs the Advisor that are designed to prevent conflicts of interest;</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">any business or personal relationship of the Advisor with a member of the committee;</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">any stock of the corporation owned by the Advisor; and</span></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">any business or personal relationship of the Advisor or the person employing the Advisor with an executive officer of the corporation.</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><table style="border-collapse:collapse;display:inline-table;margin-bottom:5pt;vertical-align:text-bottom;width:97.727%"><tr><td style="width:1.0%"/><td style="width:98.900%"/><td style="width:0.1%"/></tr><tr><td colspan="3" style="background-color:#deebf6;border-bottom:6pt solid #0070c0;border-top:6pt solid #0070c0;padding:2px 1pt 2px 1.02pt;text-align:left;vertical-align:middle"><span style="color:#0070c0;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Nominations and Corporate Governance Committee Charter</span></td></tr></table></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">1. Purpose of the Committee</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The primary purpose of the nominations and corporate governance committee (the 'committee') is to monitor compliance with good corporate governance standards; to identify individuals qualified to become board members; to recommend to the board director nominees for election at the annual </span></div><div style="height:45pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">203</span></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"/><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%"> </span></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">meeting of shareholders or for election by the board to fill open seats between annual meetings; to recommend to the board committee appointments for directors, including appointments as chair and vice-chair of such committees; to review and make recommendations to the board regarding non-employee director compensation; and to develop and recommend to the board corporate governance guidelines applicable to the corporation.  Long term value creation requires strong corporate governance to ensure appropriate transparency and accountability.  The committee aims to build and maintain an engaged and diverse board whose composition is appropriate in light of the corporation&#8217;s needs and strategy.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">2. Committee Membership</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall consist of no fewer than three members. Committee members shall be appointed by the board of directors from among the independent directors, who shall serve at the pleasure of the board, but only so long as each member continues to be a director of the corporation. The actual number of members shall be determined from time to time by resolution of the board.  Members of the committee should be suitably knowledgeable in matters pertaining to corporate governance. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.65pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">3. Committee Structure and Operation</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The chair and vice-chair of the committee shall be designated by the board from among the members of the committee. The committee shall fix its own rules of procedure and shall meet where and as provided by such rules or by resolution of the committee. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The chair, or in that person's absence, the vice-chair or in the vice-chair's absence, an alternate designated by the committee, shall: </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;preside at committee meetings; </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;ensure that meetings of the committee are held in accordance with this charter; and </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-left:45.35pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(c)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review, and modify if necessary the agenda of the meetings of this committee in advance to ensure that the committee may effectively carry out its duties. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:5pt;margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">A majority of the members of the committee shall constitute a quorum thereof. Every question shall be decided by a majority of the votes cast on the question and in the case of an equality of votes, the chair of the meeting shall be entitled to a second or casting vote. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall designate its secretary.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Meetings of the committee may be called by any member.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall act only on the affirmative vote of a majority of the members at a meeting or by unanimous written consent.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee may establish subcommittees consisting of one or more members to carry out such duties as the committee may delegate.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">4. Committee Activities</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The following shall be the common recurring activities of the committee in carrying out its purpose. These activities are set forth as a guide with the understanding that the committee may diverge from this guide as appropriate given the circumstances.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall:</span></div><div style="height:45pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">204</span></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"/><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%"> </span></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.65pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(a)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:9.07pt">provide oversight regarding issues of corporate governance as they apply to the corporation, including the effectiveness of the system of corporate governance, and the board's relationship with management, and report to the board on such matters.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.65pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(b)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:9.07pt">annually review the company&#8217;s proxy circular and approve the company&#8217;s statement of corporate governance practice</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.65pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(c)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;provide oversight regarding the annual assessment of the effectiveness and contribution of the board and its committees. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.65pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(d)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;make recommendations to the board as to the appropriate size of the board with a view to facilitating effective decision-making.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.65pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(e)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review and recommend to the board of directors any modifications to the charters of the board or any of its committees.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.65pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(f)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review the qualifications of existing directors and individuals suggested as potential candidates for director of the corporation, including candidates suggested by shareholders, and consider for nomination any of such individuals who are deemed qualified pursuant to the provisions of the board charter.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.65pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(g)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:10.28pt">annually, recommend to the board the nominees to be proposed by the board for election as directors of the corporation at the annual meeting of shareholders and recommend to the board a candidate for lead director.</span></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.65pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(h)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:10.28pt">recommend to the board candidates for election as directors of the corporation to fill open seats on the board between annual meetings, including vacancies created by an increase in the authorized number of directors.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.65pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(i)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:13.62pt">consider resignations tendered by directors in the event of:</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:67.5pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-4.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">i.</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:4.01pt">the majority shareholder&#8217;s holdings falling below 50%, for any non-contested election of directors in the event a nominee standing for election by shareholders in a non-contested election receives a greater number of votes withheld from his or her election than votes for such election and, in any such case, refer the matter to the board with the committee's recommendation whether such resignation should be accepted, or</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:67.5pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-4.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">ii.</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:1.79pt">a change of circumstance as described in section 10(b)(ii) of the board charter.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(j)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review the remuneration of independent directors, including the lead director, and make such recommendations to the board with respect thereto as it may deem advisable.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(k)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review present plans, programs or arrangements, and any proposed terms of any new plans, programs or arrangements, for the benefit of independent directors, and make such recommendations to the board with respect thereto as it may deem advisable.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(l)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;review and recommend to the board guidelines to be adopted relating to tenure of independent directors.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(m)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;provide recommendations to the board concerning committee structure of the board, committee operations, committee member qualifications, and committee member appointment.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(n)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;provide oversight and recommendations regarding director education.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(o)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;make recommendations to the board on matters related to director and officer liability protections including corporate indemnification and director and officer insurance.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(p)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;require attendances at its meetings by members of management, as the committee may direct.</span></div><div style="height:45pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">205</span></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"/><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%"> </span></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-22.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(q)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;undertake such additional activities within the scope of its responsibilities as it may deem appropriate. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:3pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">5. Committee Evaluation</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee will annually complete a self-evaluation of the committee's own performance and effectiveness and will consider whether any changes to the committee&#8217;s charter are appropriate. </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">6. Resources and Authority of the Committee</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee has the authority to retain such outside advisors, including legal counsel or other experts, as it deems appropriate, and to approve the fees and expenses of such advisors. Without limiting the foregoing, the committee will have sole authority to retain and terminate any search firm to be used by the committee to identify director candidates and any consultant used by the committee to evaluate non-employee director compensation.</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div><table style="border-collapse:collapse;display:inline-table;margin-bottom:5pt;vertical-align:text-bottom;width:97.727%"><tr><td style="width:1.0%"/><td style="width:98.900%"/><td style="width:0.1%"/></tr><tr><td colspan="3" style="background-color:#deebf6;border-bottom:6pt solid #0070c0;border-top:6pt solid #0070c0;padding:2px 1pt 2px 1.02pt;text-align:left;vertical-align:middle"><span style="color:#0070c0;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Finance Committee Charter</span></td></tr></table></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-left:18pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">1.</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;padding-left:9.67pt">Purpose of the Committee </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The primary purpose of the finance committee (the &#8216;committee&#8217;) is to provide oversight and guidance regarding the corporation&#8217;s capital structure/capital allocation, financial policies, practices and strategies.  The committee is responsible for ensuring that such matters align with the corporation&#8217;s strategy and are aimed at the generation of long-term value and shall take such action and make such reports and recommendations to the board of directors as it deems advisable.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:12pt;padding-left:18pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">2.</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;padding-left:9.67pt">Committee Membership </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall consist of no fewer than three members, to be appointed by the board of directors from among (a) the independent directors; and (b) the non-independent directors who are not members of the corporation&#8217;s management, who shall serve at the pleasure of the board, but only so long as he or she continues to be a director of the corporation. The actual number of members shall be determined from time to time by resolution of the board.  Members of the committee should be suitably knowledgeable in matters pertaining to corporate finance.</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-left:18pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">3. &#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Committee Structure and Operation </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The chair and vice-chair of the committee shall be designated by the board from among the members of the committee. The committee shall fix its own rules of procedure and shall meet where and as provided by such rules or by resolution of the committee. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The chair, or in that person's absence, the vice-chair or in the vice-chair's absence, an alternate designated by the committee, shall: </span></div><div style="margin-top:9pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(a)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:5.78pt">preside at committee meetings; </span></div><div style="margin-top:9pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(b)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:5.78pt">ensure that meetings of the committee are held in accordance with this charter; and </span></div><div style="margin-top:9pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(c)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:6.34pt">review, and modify if necessary the agenda of the meetings of this committee in advance to ensure that the committee may effectively carry out its duties. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">A majority of the members of the committee shall constitute a quorum thereof. Every question shall be decided by a majority of the votes cast on the question and in the case of an equality of votes, the chair of the meeting shall be entitled to a second or casting vote. </span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall designate its secretary.</span></div><div style="height:45pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><span style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Meetings of the committee may be called by any member.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall act only on the affirmative vote of a majority of the members at a meeting or by unanimous written consent.</span></div><div style="margin-top:10pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee may establish subcommittees consisting of one or more members to carry out such duties as the committee may delegate.</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;padding-left:18pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The following shall be the common recurring activities of the committee in carrying out its purpose. These activities are set forth as a guide with the understanding that the committee may diverge from this guide as appropriate given the circumstances.</span></div><div style="margin-top:9pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee shall:</span></div><div style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:5.78pt">review, and make recommendations to the board, as the committee deems appropriate, regarding the corporation&#8217;s capital structure / capital allocation, and its financial policies, practices and strategies, which may include the following:</span></div><div style="margin-top:9pt;padding-left:54pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span share repurchase programs;</span></div><div style="margin-top:9pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:13.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(iii) investment of pension assets and the funding of pension obligations;</span></div><div style="margin-top:9pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:13.5pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(iv) capital plan including significant capital appropriations;</span></div><div style="margin-top:9pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:13.5pt"><span significant investments, acquisitions and divestitures by the corporation, including        discussion of possible mergers and other transactions, and their financial impact.</span></div><div may direct. </span></div><div style="margin-top:9pt;padding-left:36pt;padding-right:8.3pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:6.34pt">undertake such additional activities within the scope of its responsibilities as it may deem appropriate. </span></div><div style="margin-top:9pt;padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee will make such reports and recommendations to the board with respect thereto as it may deem advisable.</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee will annually complete a self-evaluation of the committee&#8217;s own performance and effectiveness and will consider whether any changes to the committee&#8217;s charter are appropriate.</span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span><br/></span></div><div style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;padding-left:9.67pt">Resources and Authority of the Committee </span></div><div style="padding-right:8.3pt"><span style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The committee has the authority, in its sole discretion, to retain and oversee the work of such outside advisors, including legal counsel, financial advisors or other experts, as it deems appropriate; to approve the fees and expenses of such advisors with funding provided by the corporation; and to incur such other ordinary administrative expenses as are necessary or appropriate in carrying out its duties.</span></div><div
